## JARVIS Telegram v3 - talk to JARVIS from your phone
Only messages from the owner's chat ID are answered; everyone else is ignored.
Setup: select **JARVIS Telegram** in *Telegram Trigger* and *Reply on Telegram*, and **OmniRoute** in both *Call* nodes. Save, then switch the workflow to **Active** (Publish).
Only one Telegram trigger per bot can be active at a time.
